title: MediBayes educational model
disclaimer: Educational prototype. Probabilities are illustrative and many are assumed. Not medical advice.

diseases.name: Influenza
diseases.description: Seasonal viral infection with abrupt fever, aches and fatigue.

diseases.name: Common cold
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Usually clinical diagnosis; no test needed

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.description: SARS-CoV-2 infection with highly variable presentation.

diseases.name: Allergic rhinitis
diseases.description: IgE-mediated nasal and ocular allergy (hay fever).

diseases.name: Strep throat
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Rapid antigen detection test / throat culture

diseases.name: Bronchitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the bronchi, dominated by cough.
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Clinical; chest X-ray only if pneumonia is suspected

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: Infection of the lung parenchyma; potentially serious.
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Chest X-ray, pulse oximetry, blood tests

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis
diseases.description: Infectious inflammation of the stomach and intestines.
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Usually clinical; stool test if severe or prolonged

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: Recurrent neurological headache disorder, often with photophobia and nausea.

diseases.name: Type 2 diabetes
diseases.description: Chronic metabolic disorder with raised blood glucose.

diseases.name: No disease / other
diseases.description: Everything not covered by the ten modelled diseases, including healthy.
diseases.confirmatoryTest: Consult a clinician if symptoms persist

symptoms.label: Fatigue
symptoms.description: Unusual tiredness or lack of energy.

symptoms.label: Cough
symptoms.description: Any cough, productive or not. Overlaps with dry cough (see limitations).

symptoms.label: Shortness of breath
symptoms.description: Difficulty breathing or feeling breathless at rest or light activity.

symptoms.label: Chest pain
symptoms.description: Pain or tightness in the chest, often worse on breathing.

symptoms.label: Sore throat
symptoms.description: Pain or scratchiness in the throat, worse when swallowing.

symptoms.label: Loss of smell
symptoms.description: Reduced or absent sense of smell or taste.

symptoms.label: Headache
symptoms.description: Pain in the head, any type.

symptoms.label: Diarrhea
symptoms.description: Three or more loose or watery stools per day.

symptoms.label: Abdominal pain
symptoms.description: Cramps or pain in the belly.

symptoms.label: Frequent urination
symptoms.description: Needing to urinate much more often than usual (polyuria).
